structure: Retained the primary scientific law and parameters unchanged. Each independent woman receives a randomly sampled Hb band and paired continuous measurements. Hb uses a positive-conditioned reversed Weibull below 12, bounded probit-normal between 12 and 14, and shifted Weibull above 14. Conditional log ferritin is an increasing two-slope transformation of a normal variable; Gaussian copulas provide within-band dependence. Supplied generated-only checks support retaining the aggregate calibration but do not validate the assumed within-band dependence.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Hb band probabilities, means, and SDs
parameter_provenance.use: Counts normalized into population band probabilities; reported moments calibrate continuous Hb distributions. Conditioning the lowest band's Hb on positivity slightly changes its nominal moments.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Ferritin geometric means, geometric SDs, and depletion probabilities by Hb band
parameter_provenance.source: CHNS A-only Table 2, reconciled with Table 1
parameter_provenance.use: The two-slope log-ferritin distribution matches each band's depletion probability and first two log moments at the population level.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Within-band Gaussian copula correlations of 0.55, 0.15, and 0.05
parameter_provenance.source: Scientific assumptions, qualitatively informed by Zhu et al. Table III
parameter_provenance.use: Assumes positive dependence concentrated at low Hb and weakening at higher Hb. Zhu's severe-anemia ferritin gradient supports the qualitative pattern, not these numerical values.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Distributional transport to other same-design CHNS communities
parameter_provenance.source: Target definition and separation of the evidence populations
parameter_provenance.use: CHNS provides quantitative calibration. Hebei observations are not pooled with CHNS, and Zhu's adjusted odds ratio is not used as the requested crude odds ratio.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted crude odds ratio
requested_estimands.definition: Odds of hb_g_dl <12 among ferritin_ug_l <15 divided by those odds among ferritin_ug_l >=15.
requested_estimands.population_anchor: The model's threshold probabilities reproduce CHNS cells proportional to 123, 83, 207, and 710, implying OR = (123*710)/(83*207), approximately 5.083. Finite samples fluctuate naturally.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted Spearman rank correlation
requested_estimands.definition: Correlation between ranks of continuous, uncorrected hb_g_dl and ferritin_ug_l in the same generated women.
requested_estimands.population_anchor: Between-band dependence follows the CHNS conditional ferritin distributions; within-band dependence follows the nominated copulas. No observed Spearman estimate is available.

limitations: The most consequential remaining assumption is within-band dependence. Its numerical copula correlations are not identified by the supplied aggregates and materially affect Spearman correlation; matching the tables cannot resolve this.
Transport assumes the evidence communities adequately represent other communities under the same CHNS design. Community heterogeneity is not separately estimated.
Pregnancy and inflammation remain implicit in the complete-case mixture. Measurements are uncorrected, and associations have no causal interpretation.
Band-specific distribution shapes are approximations. The broad upper-Hb tail follows the reported SD and has no physiological upper bound.
Calibration summaries are treated as fixed; their estimation uncertainty and clustered-design uncertainty are not propagated. People are sampled independently as requested.
checks_actually_performed: Reconciled counts: Hb bands total 1123; depleted counts total 330; threshold cells reconstruct as 123, 83, 207, and 710.
Checked the population calibration algebra: the ferritin transformation fixes its threshold quantile and first two log moments; threshold cells imply a crude odds ratio of approximately 5.083.
Reviewed the supplied worker's generated-only results: all four threshold cell fractions differ from A by less than 0.0015, and all Hb band fractions differ by less than 0.0039.

Reviewed the supplied worker's conditional summaries: Hb means differ by less than 0.009 g/dL, Hb SDs by less than 0.054 g/dL, ferritin geometric means by less than 0.31 micrograms/L, and ferritin geometric SDs by less than 0.017.

Reviewed the model lookup, seed-based independent sampling, unique integer row IDs, positive measurements, and required column order. No additional code execution, seed selection, held-out comparison, or empirical Spearman validation was performed in this review.
